lines.text: You've probably heard that swallowing gum takes seven years to digest.
When you swallow gum, it slides down your esophagus into your stomach.
Your powerful stomach acids break down the sweeteners and flavorings,
but your body cannot dissolve the rubbery gum base.
Instead of staying stuck for seven years,
pushing it through your intestines just like normal food.
Within a few days, it quietly leaves your body.
Just don't swallow a huge wad at once, or it could cause a blockage.
